headline: [Yemen War Shift!] Houthis Advance to [60 km] From Aden as Government Retreats
sub: Forces pull back from Bab el-Mandeb Strait
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Yemen War Shift! Houthis Advance to 60 km From Aden as Government Retreats

Yemen's Houthis have advanced to about 60 km (37 miles) from Aden, the temporary seat of Yemen's internationally recognised government, military and government sources told AFP on Sunday. Earlier the same day, Saudi-backed government forces said they were pulling out of areas near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending Aden.

🔹 Sources say the Houthis seized two districts in Lahj province and reached the Al-Kharaz camp, where the UN refugee agency says 9,600 refugees are at risk.
🔹 The Houthis now say they hold more than 150 km of the Red Sea coast that government forces left. Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most important shipping routes.
🔹 Government forces have been building sandbag defences and digging tunnels around Aden. The UN says more than 1,600 people have been killed since fighting restarted in July.

💬 What do you think will happen next in Yemen? 👇

Sources: AFP, Reuters, Al Jazeera

headline: [Big Build-Up!] [Third US Aircraft Carrier] Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions
sub: Iran says it will not wait to be attacked
caption:
⚓ Big Build-Up! Third US Aircraft Carrier Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions

The US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike group have arrived in the Middle East, a US official told ABC News and Al Jazeera. It entered the area of US Central Command on Sunday, November 15.

🔹 The US now has three aircraft carriers in the region: the Roosevelt, the USS George H.W. Bush and the USS George Washington.
🔹 Late on Sunday, Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran "will not wait for the US to attack first."
🔹 The move comes as tensions with Iran stay high and Donald Trump begins a trip to Asia this week, with Iran expected to be discussed at talks with China's Xi Jinping.

💬 What do you think this means for the region? 👇

Sources: ABC News, Al Jazeera, Axios

headline: [Perfect Debut!] Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins [WTA Finals] Without Losing a Set
caption:
🏆 Perfect Debut! Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins WTA Finals Without Losing a Set

Russia's Mirra Andreeva won the WTA Finals on Sunday, beating Ukraine's Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 in the final at Indian Wells, California. It was her first time playing at the season-ending event.

🔹 Andreeva, 19, won all five of her matches without dropping a set.
🔹 She takes home $3.37 million, the biggest possible prize at the event.
🔹 The win lifts her to a career-high world No. 2 in the rankings.

💬 Can Andreeva become world No. 1 next year? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AFP

headline: [43-Game Run Over!] 10-Man England Stun Spain [3-2] in Madrid
caption:
⚽ 43-Game Run Over! 10-Man England Stun Spain 3-2 in Madrid

England beat world champions Spain 3-2 in the UEFA Nations League on Sunday night at the Metropolitano stadium in Madrid. The result ended Spain's 43-match unbeaten run.

🔹 Harry Kane scored a penalty just before half-time, then Ezri Konsa (53rd minute) and Ben White added goals to make it 3-0.
🔹 England's Elliot Anderson was sent off for a foul on Lamine Yamal. Mikel Oyarzabal scored the penalty, and substitute Nico Williams made it 3-2.
🔹 England finish top of Group A3 on goal difference. Both teams go through to the Nations League quarter-finals in March.

💬 Was this England's best win in years? 👇

Sources: AFP, ESPN, The National

headline: [First-Ever Failure!] ULA Rocket Loses [40 Amazon Satellites] After Launch
caption:
🚀 First-Ever Failure! ULA Rocket Loses 40 Amazon Satellites After Launch

A Vulcan rocket from United Launch Alliance (ULA), a joint company of Boeing and Lockheed Martin, failed after lifting off from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on Sunday, November 15. All 40 satellites it carried for Amazon's Leo internet network were lost.

🔹 ULA said the rocket "suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit." The cause is not yet known.
🔹 It is ULA's first full mission failure since the company was formed in 2006. It was the fifth Vulcan flight and its first in nine months.
🔹 ULA says it will investigate with its customer and return to flight as quickly as possible. NASA has offered to help. Amazon Leo is building a satellite internet network to compete with SpaceX's Starlink.

💬 Can Amazon still catch up with Starlink? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Anadolu Agency, Spaceflight Now

headline: [Legend Returns!] Ronaldinho, 46, Plays First Match in [11 Years]
caption:
⚽ Legend Returns! Ronaldinho, 46, Plays First Match in 11 Years

Brazil legend Ronaldinho played his first official match in more than 11 years on Sunday, November 15, for Italian third-tier club Ravenna. Ravenna beat local rivals Forlì 2-0 at the sold-out Stadio Bruno Benelli.

🔹 Ronaldinho, 46, played the whole first half and helped build the move for Giulio Donati's opening goal. He had been expected to play only about 30 minutes.
🔹 His last official match was for Fluminense in Brazil on September 26, 2015. He joined Ravenna as an investor in August.
🔹 Fans gave him a standing ovation when he went off at half-time. He did not rule out playing again, saying: "If the president calls me, I'll be back."

💬 Should Ronaldinho keep playing? 👇

Sources: BBC, Sky Sports, Anadolu Agency
